chunks: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
ai.seo_question: What does the title 'Rasool Ameen' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's 'Amanah' (trustworthiness) not merely as a personal trait but as a divine guarantee of the message's integrity, often linked to the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility). It serves as a foundational proof for his authority among the people, distinguishing him from other prophets who faced skepticism, thereby reinforcing the legitimacy of his mission as conveyed through the Ahl al-Bayt.
